rationale: The digest shows emailservice CPU usage spiked by 2593% (z=+304.99) with corresponding latency and socket increases, while all other services remained near baseline. This CPU saturation in emailservice cascades to checkoutservice and frontendservice, explaining the frontend errors and high trace latencies.

proposed_fix.description: Scale up emailservice CPU limits or optimize its processing loop to handle the load.
